role: Pinned fixture and source-derived acceptance design; not an Android execution success record

preparation.closure: Recursively resolve exact locked dependencies, peers, and target-compatible optional dependencies using nearest npm node_modules paths. Installed optional peers are retained. Every selected package retains every regular tar file, including development resources and foreign prebuilds shipped in the same package.
preparation.root_exception: The original dsh public CLI package is retained unchanged but its unrelated Web/ACP/optional profile dependency roots are not expanded. This is a selected official-profile fixture, not a complete npm installation of every DSH profile.
evidence: Every package tarball checked against pinned official npm SHA512 SRI
All 24424 materialized path/mode/bytes/SHA256 rows match separately generated index
Closure independently checked against the materialized npm package manifests without loading package code

eof_profile_acceptance.stdin: A finite, empty input stream that reaches EOF
eof_profile_acceptance.preconditions: Use a fresh dedicated runtime project and fresh work/home/tmp directories; do not forward inherited host credentials, proxy configuration or user .env files. No prompt, session/query, session/prompt or tool execution is issued.
eof_profile_acceptance.stdout: No CLI-help or version marker is expected. This is the real stdio profile, not a mock profile or patched entrypoint.
eof_profile_acceptance.stderr: Must not contain loader/startup failure, module-not-found or native binding failure; preserve diagnostics on failure.
eof_profile_acceptance.why_eof_is_meaningful: sdk-app's successful action invokes exitOnStdinEnd. That callback waits for launcher appReady; runProfile commits appReady only after boot and host setup succeed, the root fiber is active and loader exists. EOF then requests bounded shutdown and root disposal. sdk-minimal's official agent-loop configuration starts with agents: [].

artifacts.assert: JSON name == dsh-profile-sdk-minimal, private == true, dsh.profile.bundles exactly [@deepseek-ai/dsh-sdk-minimal]
Regular, nonempty profile root created by the original launcher; initial source template is a comment plus empty YAML list
Regular initialized profile patch file exists
Regular initialized profile workspace file exists; this does not mean pnpm ran

later_handshake.requires: Bidirectional controlled stdio: await initialize reply before sending shutdown; finite prequeued lines/EOF can race asynchronous handlers.
later_handshake.no_model_request_reason: initialize waits for loader settlement and calls resolveCallConfig/resolveModel metadata. The official listing cache does not call its fetch loader when no credential exists. Generation and resolveAuth are separate paths; do not invoke prompt/query. This is source-derived and still requires guest verification.

bundle_protocol.length_prefix: uint32 little endian: number of UTF-8 JSON index bytes immediately following
bundle_protocol.index: schema_version=1, format, name, guest_prefix=/opt/dsh, file_count, total_bytes, package_count, source_manifest_sha256, files[]
bundle_protocol.file_record: path is absolute guest /opt/dsh/...; mode is POSIX permission integer 0..511; bytes is exact raw length; sha256 is lowercase hex
bundle_protocol.payload: Consecutive raw file bytes in index.files order. No padding, directory entries, file headers or separators. Require exact decompressed EOF after the final file and complete gzip CRC validation.
bundle_protocol.limits: Index <=16 MiB; <=100000 files; each file <=256 MiB; total payload <=2 GiB; compressed asset <=256 MiB
bundle_protocol.integrity: bundle.json records compressed bytes/SHA256, raw JSON index bytes/SHA256, original assets manifest SHA256 and counts. An installer report should identify index_sha256 and actual validated counts.
bundle_protocol.publication: Validate unique rooted paths, deny links/special files, stream/hash to random same-parent temporary files, atomically rename only validated files, and map original execute bits to 0700 or default 0600. No setuid/setgid or arbitrary archive permissions.

needed: Read and write regular files/directories, stat/access/readdir/realpath
ESM/CJS resolution and the actual require-builtin N-API addon
Node asynchronous file operations, threads/futex/event loop, pipes/EOF, timers, random bytes
SIGINT/SIGTERM handler registration and bounded disposal
first_boot_capabilities.web_followup: Original bin.js web --no-open --host 127.0.0.1 --port 0 needs network sockets/listen/accept plus live config and credential watchers. Keep all Web frontend assets. Fresh empty isolated home and DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; no login or chat request. Await dsh web: URL only after startup audit, then verify local HTTP and graceful shutdown.

bundle_artifact.validation: Independent host Node standard-library streaming parser checked every raw file SHA256, every path/mode/size against original manifest, compressed SHA256, exact decompressed EOF and gzip CRC; no DSH package code executed.
